Emma, Luke—I commit to the 18-ton cap this month if all five of us explicitly agree before choosing. I’d also support a 3-ton cap each if next month starts at 20, though we should confirm that agreement once we see the stock.

My main concern is keeping everyone coordinated after a poor recovery. Let’s agree to check the stock and settle on whole-ton caps before fishing each month, always leaving at least 5 tons. If someone exceeds an agreed cap, we should address it directly—not retaliate by overfishing and destroying everyone’s future income.

Kate, are you comfortable with 18 under those conditions, or would Luke’s 17-ton alternative earn your support?
